title: MicroProfile Health quickstart is failing
body:
It looks related to the latest changes that were merged (https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/4987).

@loicmathieu @jmartisk could you have a look?

It's executing:
```
+ cd microprofile-fault-tolerance-quickstart
+ mvn clean install -Pnative
```
but fails right in the Surefire tests so it's not a native specific issue.
